findings.failureScenario: A merge preview fails for options X (spawn/plan error or the job returns Err) so app.merge.failed_options = Some(X). The user closes the dialog, selects a different set of photos and reopens the same merge kind: open() resets ids, error, preview and preview_pixels but never clears failed_options, and MergeDialog::for_command(command) yields the same default X. In poll(), stale = current != Some(opts) && !last_failed_matches(app, opts) is false because failed_options == X, so no preview is ever spawned for the new selection; with error cleared to None the preview box stays blank with no progress or message until the user changes an option.
findings.action: Clear app.merge.failed_options in merge::open (and wherever app.merge.ids is replaced), or key the failed record on (ids, options) instead of options alone.

findings.failureScenario: In dialogs::show, a confirm_dialog Err is only reported for Import/Export/ContactSheet/NewAlbum/NewSmartAlbum/SmartRules/KeywordTag/KeywordSet/SynchronizeFolder (toast) and SamModel; every other Err falls into `_ => close = true`, dropping the message. app.run does not toast errors itself. Example: Edit Capture Time with a typed time that is not a date makes photo.setCaptureTime return `... is not a date`, and the dialog simply closes with nothing changed and no message; likewise Rename Photos (on-disk rename failure), Merge (start_final 'a merge is already running' / plan error), Rename Keyword, Label Names, Paste Settings, Cull and Delete failures vanish silently and the user's input is lost.
findings.action: Report every confirm_dialog error (at least a toast, ideally keeping the dialog open as for Export) instead of the catch-all close.
